√vap1 'strew'
perfect: [1.] vápati vápate etc. V.+ upet 
perfect: uvāpa ūpús etc. V.+ vavāpa ūpe etc. 
aorist: [1.] upyāt vāpi -- [3.] avīvapat -- [4.] avāpsīt etc. B.+ avapta 
future: [1.] vapsyáti etc. vapiṣyati etc. E.+ -- [2.] vaptā 
verbal: uptá V.+ upita vapta uptvā E.+ -úpya V.+ 
secondary: passive: upyáte etc. V.+ -- intensive: vāvap- -- desiderative: vivapsa- -- causative: vāpayati etc. B.+ 
derivatives: vapá vapā́ V.B.S. -úpya B. vāpa B.+ -vāpaka E. -vāpin C. vāpya B.+ vápana AV.+ vapanīya C. vāpana C. vāpī E.+ upti C. vaptavya C. vaptṛ E.+ vapra S.+ -vapiṣṭha B. -vāpayitṛ B. 
Compare the following root.

√vap2 'shear'
present: [1.] vapati vapate etc. 
verbal: upta uptvā -upya 
secondary: vāpayati etc. vāpayīta 
derivatives: vápana B.+ vāpa C. vāpana S.+ váptṛ V.B.S. 
Doubtless the same with the preceding root: 'scatter off from one'.
